title.narrative: Scaling-up Shock Responsive Social Protection Project

description.narrative: The development objectives of Scaling Up Shock Responsive Social Protection Project is to protect poor and vulnerable households' consumption in response to shocks in Zambia. This project has one component. The component, Social Cash Transfer (SCT), will finance bi-monthly cash transfers to poor and vulnerable households on the SCT.
To protect poor and vulnerable households' consumption in response to shocks in Zambia
